executive_summary_zh: 今天候选内容整体信号偏弱，主要是 GitHub Changelog 的聚合页与一条模型下线通知，缺少深度技术细节、评测数据或架构设计说明。
唯一相对值得注意的是 GitHub Copilot 的模型弃用公告，因为它直接影响企业级代理/集成的模型路由、策略配置与兼容性维护。
executive_summary_en: Today's candidate set is weak overall: mostly GitHub Changelog aggregation pages plus one model deprecation notice, with little technical depth, evaluation data, or architecture detail.

The only somewhat material item is GitHub Copilot's model deprecation notice, because it directly affects enterprise agent/integration model routing, policy configuration, and compatibility maintenance.

items.title: Selected models in GitHub Copilot deprecated
items.summary_zh: GitHub 宣布在 Copilot 的所有体验中停用一批模型，包括 Copilot Chat、inline edits、ask/agent 模式与代码补全。被弃用的模型包括 Gemini 3.5 Flash、Gemini 3.6 Flash、Kimi K2.7 Code 和 Claude Opus 4.7，对应建议迁移到 Gemini 3.8 Flash、Kimi K3 与 Claude Opus 5.5。企业管理员可能需要在模型策略中显式启用替代模型。
items.summary_en: GitHub announced deprecation of several models across all Copilot experiences, including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask/agent modes, and code completions. Deprecated models include Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Kimi K2.7 Code, and Claude Opus 4.7, with suggested migrations to Gemini 3.8 Flash, Kimi K3, and Claude Opus 5.5. Enterprise admins may need to explicitly enable replacement models via Copilot model policies.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这不是功能发布，而是平台兼容性变化：凡是依赖 Copilot 指定模型、做策略白名单、成本控制、回归测试或产线自动化的团队，都需要更新配置和基线。对工程平台负责人而言，模型生命周期管理正成为 AI 编程工具治理的一部分。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is less a feature launch than a platform compatibility change: any team relying on specific Copilot models for policy allowlists, cost controls, regression testing, or production automation needs to refresh configs and baselines. For platform leaders, model lifecycle management is becoming part of AI coding governance.
key_takeaways_zh: Copilot 的多种入口共享同一模型弃用面，说明模型变更会同时影响聊天、编辑、代理与补全工作流。
企业版管理员需要检查 model policies，否则替代模型即使可用也可能不会出现在用户选择器或集成流程中。
key_takeaways_en: The deprecation spans multiple Copilot surfaces, implying that model changes can simultaneously affect chat, edit, agent, and completion workflows.
Enterprise admins need to verify model policies; otherwise replacement models may not appear in user selectors or integration flows even if technically available.

如果团队通过 Copilot API、CLI 或代理流程固定某个模型，需建立弃用监控与自动回退/切换机制。
implications_en: AI coding model versions should be brought into formal change management: track defaults, replacements, regression outcomes, and policy dependencies.
If teams pin models in Copilot API, CLI, or agent workflows, they need deprecation monitoring plus automated fallback/switchover mechanisms.

除非你正在做 GitHub 产品运维盘点，否则今天这些聚合页里的其他零散条目缺乏足够上下文，不适合作为日报重点。
what_to_ignore_en: The GitHub Changelog landing and archive pages are not worth including on their own; they are indexes, not high-signal primary technical content.
Unless you're doing GitHub product operations tracking, the other scattered entries surfaced via these aggregate pages lack enough context to merit digest inclusion.
